changelog:
v3.7.13 — Movies/Series Grid Crash Fix

Fixes a crash when browsing Movies or Series and switching categories — most common on older Fire TV Sticks (AFTSS / mt8695). The grid could try to draw an invalid position right after a category finished loading and force-close the app.

• The poster grid now always lands on a valid item the instant new content loads, eliminating the 'Invalid item position' crash that had returned on slower devices.
• Browsing and back-navigation focus restore are unchanged — just no more crash.
